structured.feedback: It makes unsupported claims ("without stripping natural oils", "wet and dry hair") and a "Long-Lasting Value" section that reviews contradict, which breaks the no-overpromising rule, and it repeats itself ("At 16 oz, this 16-ounce bottle", repeated "smoother" and "easier to manage").
